questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

335 × 5 ÷ 7 + 65 − 213 = 321
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given : 335 × 5 ÷ 7 + 65 − 213 = 321 

According to the question, after interchanging the signs:

Option 1) + and =

335 × 5 ÷ 7 + 65 − 213 = 321 ⇒ 335 × 5 ÷ 7 = 65 − 213 + 321

⇒ 335 × __**5 ÷ 7**__ = __**65 + 321**__ − 213

⇒ __**335 × 0.71**__ = __**386 − 213**__

⇒ 238 ≠ 173 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) ÷ and ×

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number.

121 ∶ 23 ∶ ∶ ? ∶ 14 ∶ ∶ 166 ∶ 32
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number × 5) + 6 = 1st number.

Now,

For, 121 : 23

⇒ (23 × 5) + 6 = 115 + 6 = 121.

For, 166 : 32

⇒ (32 × 5) + 6 = 160 + 6 = 166.

Similarly, for ? : 14

⇒ (14 × 5) + 6 = 70 + 6 = 76.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some balloons are bags.

All belts are bags.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some bags are balloons.

II. Some belts are balloons.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24c4041f2d4ef2d6604069990b2609aa29109f10d6f28c83953457c46c2f7c39.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4110de661202a5826c3adcac0e079a6396b2544b9bfca31f6a413ff0fbf4e97.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some bags are balloons → Follow (As some balloons are bags. As some part of balloons is common with bags, therefore it is true.)

II. Some belts are balloons → Does not follow (As some balloons are bags and all belts are bags. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

b _ d _ p b c _ p _ _ c _ p p b _ _ p p
questions.solution:
Given series: b _ d _ p b c _ p _ _ c _ p p b _ _ p p 

Option 1) cpdpdbdc → b __c__ d __p__ p b c __d__ p __p__ __d__ c __b__ p p b __d__ __c__ p p → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) cpdpbdcd → b __**c**__ d __**p**__ p b c __**d**__ p __**p**__ __**b**__ c __**d**__ p p b __**c**__ __**d**__ p p → (It follows the pattern of: bcdpp - bcdpp - bcdpp - bcdpp)

Option 3) cdppbddc → b __c__ d __d__ p b c __p__ p __p__ __b__ c __d__ p p b __d__ __c__ p p → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) pcdpbdcd → b __p__ d __c__ p b c __d__ p __p__ __b__ c __d__ p p b __c__ __d__ p p → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
